project.name: Amhara Integrated Agriculture Ecosystem
project.tagline: From Land Intelligence to Market Delivery

domains.title: Plan
domains.question: What should be grown where, and for whom?

domains.title: Produce
domains.question: Is the plan being carried out, and is it on track?

domains.title: Move
domains.question: Does produce reach the buyer with minimal loss?

domains.title: Sell & Learn
domains.question: Did farmers earn more, and what changes next season?

stages.title: Land Intelligence & Suitability
stages.summary: Where can each crop grow, and how well? The root layer that every later stage builds on.
questions: Which plots are S1, S2, S3 or N for each candidate crop and season?
What are the soil, slope and erosion constraints on each plot?
How are smallholder plots grouped into planning clusters, given land-use certificates?
components: Land availability and land-use certificate (tenure) records
Soil properties: fertility, pH, texture, drainage, depth
Topography: elevation, slope, aspect, erosion risk
Land suitability classification (FAO framework, MCDA/AHP, ML/DL)
outputs: Plot x crop suitability scores with uncertainty
kpis: Suitability model accuracy against field trials
Share of pilot plots mapped and classified

stages.title: Water Resource Assessment
stages.summary: How much water is actually available for each cluster, in each season, and at what sustainable rate?
questions: What surface and groundwater can each cluster use sustainably?
How does seasonal water demand compare with supply?
Where would irrigation investment unlock the most suitable land?
components: Surface water: rivers, lakes, reservoirs, streams
Groundwater availability and sustainable extraction (requires hydrogeological field data)
kpis: Share of plans within the sustainable water budget

stages.title: Climate & Seasonal Intelligence
stages.summary: When does the season start and end, and what weather risks does it carry?
questions: When will Meher and Belg rains start and stop this year?
What is the drought, flood and frost risk per cluster?
How long is the effective growing season?
components: Growing-season length; Meher and Belg planting windows

stages.title: Crop Selection & Production Planning
stages.summary: The core of the system: turn buyer demand, suitability, water and climate into a seasonal production plan.
questions: Which crop and variety should each cluster plant, on how many hectares, and when?
Which plan maximises farmer net income within land, water and demand limits?
What rotation and intercropping keep soils healthy?
components: Matching crops to soil, water and agroecology
outputs: Seasonal Production Plan (cluster x crop x variety x hectares x planting date)
kpis: Share of contracted demand covered by the plan

stages.title: Market Intelligence & Demand Forecasting
stages.summary: Start with the market: who buys what, how much, at what quality, when and at what price.
questions: What will buyers demand at harvest time, and at what price?
Which buyers can sign offtake agreements before planting?
Which competing production areas affect prices?
outputs: Demand signals (crop, tonnes, grade, delivery window, price)
kpis: Share of produce sold through planned agreements

stages.title: Input & Resource Coordination
stages.summary: Make sure seed, fertilizer, equipment and finance arrive before they are needed.
questions: What inputs does the plan require, by cluster and by date?
Which suppliers can deliver on time, and with what lead time?
Which farmers need credit or insurance to take part?
kpis: Share of inputs delivered before planting date

stages.title: Farm Implementation & Production
stages.summary: Carry out the plan in the field with registered farmers, mapped plots and extension support.
questions: Is each cluster planting the planned crop, on time?
Are irrigation and fertilizer schedules followed?
What training and support do farmers need?
components: Extension services, training and field visits

stages.title: Monitoring, Forecasting & Risk
stages.summary: Watch crops from space and from the field, forecast yields and raise early warnings.
questions: Is crop development on track for each cluster?
Where are water stress, pests or disease emerging?
How much will each cluster harvest, and when?

stages.title: Harvest & Post-harvest Management
stages.summary: Harvest at the right time, keep quality high and make every lot traceable.
questions: When should each cluster harvest to meet delivery windows?
Are labour and machinery available at that time?
Where are post-harvest losses happening?
kpis: Share of lots meeting buyer grade

stages.title: Storage, Processing & Aggregation
stages.summary: Aggregate smallholder lots into buyer-sized volumes, store safely and add value.
questions: Where should collection centres and storage be located?
How much capacity is needed, and when?
Which processing steps add the most value?

stages.title: Logistics & Transportation
stages.summary: Move produce from farm to collection centre to buyer, on time and at the lowest cost.
questions: What is the cheapest, most reliable route for each shipment?
Are trucks available when harvest peaks?
Which alternative routes exist if a road is closed?
components: Cost estimation, delivery scheduling and tracking

stages.title: Market Distribution & Customer Network
stages.summary: Deliver to buyers, settle payments fairly and on time, and feed results back into the next season.
questions: Were orders delivered in full, on time and at grade?
Were farmers paid on time?
What do buyers want differently next season?
components: Contracts with processors, supermarkets, institutions and exporters
outputs: Outcome indicators for the learning loop
kpis: Share of farmers paid on time
